scenario_description:
Objective: Make Friday’s Portland Art Museum return less awkward in wet weather while the confirmed receiving appointment and normal check-in remain usable.
Emerging Need: A rain-sleeve prep table is only worth considering after the sealed case, streetcar approach, forecast, and same-day hold board line up.
Decision Context: The useful choice depends on combining the notices with stored north-door table rules that identify eligibility, safe message contents, and the roster cutoff.
Consequence: Timely use would add a dry staging surface and easier grip handling; missing the roster simply leaves ordinary front reception in place.

parameter.title: Friday PAM secure receiving return
parameter.description: Confirmed secure-receiving return; ordinary front reception remains available for escorted hand-carry arrivals.
parameter.location: Portland Art Museum secure receiving, Portland, OR

parameter.subject: Friday secure receiving return details
parameter.body: For tomorrow's 15:00 return, please use appointment code PAM-RR-842 at check-in. The sealed hard-shell portfolio case remains assigned to your hand-carry escort; front reception can receive you without any added arrangements.

parameter.description: Day pass loaded for the Aug 28 Portland Art Museum return approach via the museum-area streetcar stop.

parameter.content: Downtown Portland Friday update: steady showers and gusty wind are expected near the Park Blocks from 14:30 to 15:30, with brief heavier bursts possible around 15:00.

parameter.subject: Friday north-door rain table availability
parameter.body: The north-door rain-sleeve prep table has remaining holds for some Friday secure-receiving arrivals. Today's roster closes at 16:00. Standard front reception remains staffed for all scheduled returns.

parameter.subject: Friday north-door rain table roster closed
parameter.body: The north-door rain-sleeve prep table roster for Friday secure-receiving arrivals closed at 16:00. Front reception and the regular check-in path remain unchanged for tomorrow.
